title: Betulinic Acid Promotes Motor Function Recovery After Spinal Cord Injury by Inhibiting Apoptosis Through Myc/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Tan, Xiuwei; Wei, Shuai; Wu, Yanlan; Meng, Jianan; Fan, Gaowei; Qin, Zhaojie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桦木酸通过Myc/NF-kappaB通路抑制凋亡促进脊髓损伤恢复，虽涉及分子对接但核心为疾病表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) imposes a remarkable burden on affected cases and their families, while current treatment options remain insufficient. This study aimed to identify and validate the molecular targets, signaling pathways, and mechanisms by which Betulinic acid (BA) exerts its therapeutic effects on SCI, providing new directions for clinical intervention. In vivo, Kunming mice underwent behavioral tests, Nissl staining, and Hematoxylin-eosin staining to evaluate motor function recovery and determine the expression levels of relevant biomarkers. Bioinformatics analyses were employed to investigate the genes involved in the SCI-BA interaction, elucidating key signaling pathways, followed by molecular docking of potential target genes. In vitro, lipopolysaccharide was used to induce a secondary SCI condition in cultured astrocytes, enabling the evaluation of BA's effects on inflammatory and apoptotic responses. The results demonstrated that BA could significantly promote motor function recovery and reduce the expression levels of inflammation-related cytokines, including IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, in SCI mice. Through bioinformatics analysis, Myc was identified as a key target of BA in SCI, and NF-kappaB and apoptosis pathways could be implicated in its mechanism of action. Both in vitro and in vivo experiments confirmed that BA could target Myc to modulate the inflammatory response in astrocytes, reducing the activation of RELA and MAPK14. In conclusion, these findings indicate that BA attenuates neuroinflammation and apoptosis via Myc and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby promoting functional recovery following SCI.
abstract_zh: 脊髓损伤（SCI）对患者及其家庭造成沉重负担，而现有治疗手段仍显不足。本研究旨在识别并验证桦木酸（Betulinic acid, BA）对SCI发挥治疗作用的分子靶点、信号通路及机制，为临床干预提供新方向。在体内实验中，昆明小鼠接受行为学测试、尼氏染色和苏木精-伊红染色，以评估运动功能恢复情况并测定相关生物标志物的表达水平。采用生物信息学分析探究参与SCI-BA相互作用的基因，阐明关键信号通路，随后对潜在靶基因进行分子对接。在体外实验中，使用脂多糖诱导培养的星形胶质细胞产生继发性SCI状态，以评估BA对炎症和凋亡反应的影响。结果表明，BA能显著促进SCI小鼠运动功能恢复，并降低炎症相关细胞因子（包括IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α）的表达水平。通过生物信息学分析，Myc被确定为BA在SCI中的关键靶点，且NF-κB和凋亡通路可能涉及其作用机制。体外和体内实验均证实，BA可通过靶向Myc调节星形胶质细胞的炎症反应，减少RELA和MAPK14的激活。总之，这些发现表明，BA通过Myc和NF-κB信号通路减轻神经炎症和凋亡，从而促进SCI后的功能恢复。
